title: Category fold resets when Sources is replaced
reproduction: Collapse Ads, rotate, then leave and return to Sources.
expected: Retain the user's chosen fold independently of whether the category is enabled.
observed: Ads reopened on rotation and on tab return.
fix: Keep per-category expansion in activity saved state and defer scroll restoration until rows exist.
test_evidence: Original debug assertion and signed UI trees; corrected debug and signed saved-task check. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/source-category.md

title: A group toggle commits separate writes and crashes on a failed member
reproduction: Disable a category with multiple enabled lists; separately inject a local failure on the second of two writes.
expected: Commit the user's action atomically or roll back all source and rule flags without a crash.
observed: Signed UI exposed an intermediate selection. Old instrumentation crashed on the second write.
fix: Queue one transaction per tap with the full membership, change only differing source flags and their rules, and handle database errors.
test_evidence: Old debug process crash; corrected Android rollback, retry, rapid taps and uninvolved category checks. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/source-category.md

title: An unrelated selection can conceal a failed write or displace Apply
reproduction: Fail a Privacy write and then successfully toggle Ads before the UI receives both completions.
expected: Privacy remains visibly failed while Ads succeeds and its Apply action stays available.
observed: The intermediate global failure flag could coalesce outcomes; failure and Apply used the same snackbar slot.
fix: Deliver each completion on the UI thread; clear only matching failed filter IDs and show the error independently of Apply.
test_evidence: Earlier build failed: rolled-back Privacy still checked. On the corrected build the inline failure remained beside Apply until retry or deletion; Ads succeeded independently. API 34 focused result.

title: A physically toggled switch can disagree with the final membership
reproduction: Swap which one of two equal-sized sources is enabled using master and child taps before Room delivers the result.
expected: Master visibly reflects the final partial group; children agree with stored flags.
observed: The aggregate count and size did not change; ordinary content comparison could leave the master visually checked.
fix: Include physically touched controls in rebind decisions on the following authoritative snapshot.
test_evidence: Android 14 failed before with '1 of 2 is not all enabled'; after, master and both child switches agreed with stored flags and rules. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/source-category.md

title: Saving or scheduling the current filters can snapshot the previous selection
reproduction: Queue a switch update, then confirm Save or choose Custom in the schedule picker before Room publishes the new rows.
expected: Use the selection after the earlier tap; a successful named save stays active.
observed: The fragment read its previous display snapshot and an earlier queued write could subsequently reset the active profile.
fix: Serialize the authoritative database read with selection writes and set the active name in the same queue entry when saving.
test_evidence: Old named-set test omitted the third URL; confirmed corrected on Android 14 with the write queue held. Scheduling uses the same ordered read; the signed daily UI path was exercised without a forced queue stall.

title: Leaving Sources can hide Apply for a selected but empty filter
reproduction: Disable the file and apply; re-enable it, then leave Sources and return without applying.
expected: Keep Apply visible until the enabled file's rules are installed.
observed: Signed app showed 1 of 1 enabled, 0 hosts and no Apply on return. Its domain resolved unblocked.
fix: Keep the apply model across tab replacement and restore a compact last-applied fingerprint conservatively on task recreation.
test_evidence: Signed old failure vs final task #16/PIDs 12351 -> 13081: Apply remained, one file rule loaded, and matched DNS changed from two answers to none. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/source-category.md

title: A failed named-set apply can crash instead of offering recovery
reproduction: Choose a named set and force a local second-rule write failure.
expected: Leave all rows and the active profile unchanged, permit retry, and keep independent protection Apply accessible.
observed: The old disk runnable let a transaction exception escape; there was no result or retry route on this path.
fix: Own the asynchronous transaction outcome, use an inline progress/error/retry status and change the active set only after DB success.
test_evidence: Real Room trigger and namedApplyRollbackKeepsActiveSetAndProtectionApplyUntilRetry passed. Both source and rule flags and active set were checked before and after retry.

title: Retry can act on a named filter set the user has since changed or deleted
reproduction: Fail a named apply, rename/delete/replace the set or edit its URL membership, then Retry.
expected: Do not silently apply a stale set or activate its deleted name.
observed: The initial retry callback directly reapplied captured name/URLs; it did not compare them with the stored set.
fix: Check the stable set ID, exact display name and URL membership immediately before the queued write; show the changed or missing result without changing protection.
test_evidence: Four Android regressions: case-only rename, deletion, replacement with identical name/URLs, and changed URLs while the retry waits in the disk queue. The unchanged-set retry also passed.

title: A schedule confirmation can remove the protection Apply action
reproduction: Change selection, schedule Current selection daily and let the confirmation expire without replacing Sources.
expected: A separate notice should not displace a pending protection action.
observed: After scheduling on 41698caa the unchanged Sources screen lost Apply; replacing the fragment brought it back.
fix: Use independent transient notices for non-actionable Sources messages; leave the snackbar available for protection Apply and retry.
test_evidence: Matched final signed schedule path: snapshots 113, 118 and 119 have the action before, during and after acknowledgment; tapping it started the real operation. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/source-category.md
